description: Core system model library providing foundational types for entity management, multi-tenant configuration, auto-increment sequences with fiscal-year number ranges and release configuration, an append-only audit trail of released documents, a comprehensive query system with support for filtering/sorting/aggregations/text-search, the System/TimeRange record used by stream-data archives, and per-tenant blueprint registry types (Installation/History/Backup) that track which blueprints have been applied, and the System/SyncOrigin record that marks entities written by a cross-tenant master-data sync.
